included.description:
• Scalable Backend Services: Architected distributed microservices using Python, Django, JavaScript, Node.js, Kafka, Redis, and PostgreSQL, powering workflows across multiple products serving 50K+ users. 
• Migrated Data Infrastructure: Contributed to migrating analytics workflows from BigQuery to Snowflake, for crossservice updates, reducing synchronization latency and cutting data processing costs by 30%. 
• Automated Internal Documentation: Engineered API documentation agents that converted backend schemas and route metadata into human readable technical docs, reducing documentation effort from hours to minutes. 
• Built Automated PR Review System: Developed an AI-powered pull request review workflow that analyzed code changes, generated review suggestions, and reduced manual review effort by 40% across backend teams. 
• Event-Driven Pipelines: Constructed real-time data pipelines and event-driven systems with Kafka and Redis, processing 100K+ daily events and cutting cross-service sync latency by 40%.

multiLocaleSummary.en_US: I don't just write code. I build the infrastructure that keeps products running at scale. I'm a FullStack Engineer currently at Suraasa, an EdTech platform helping teachers upskill and find better opportunities globally. My job is to design and maintain the systems that make Suraasa's product fast, reliable, and intelligent — from API architecture to AI integrations that power real user experiences.  🔧 What I work with: Python · Django · JavaScript · Node.js · Java · React · PostgreSQL · REST APIs · LLMs · AI/ML pipelines · Docker · Redis · Celery · Kafka🏗️ What I've shipped at Suraasa: I joined as a backend engineer and quickly moved into AI-adjacent work - integrating large language models into our platform's core workflows, building scalable data pipelines, and designing APIs consumed by thousands of users across multiple countries.  🧩 My journey: Before Suraasa, I interned at AICAN Private Limited (software engineering), worked as a web developer at Glocali.se and Page3 Events, and picked up a surprisingly broad skill set, from backend systems to design, that gives me a full-stack perspective even as I specialise in backend + AI.  I hold a B.Tech in Information Technology from Guru Tegh Bahadur Institute of Technology (GTBIT), Delhi, where the foundation in data structures, algorithms, and systems thinking still shows up in every design decision I make.  💡 What I care about: I'm drawn to problems where the backend isn't just CRUD — where you're orchestrating AI, handling concurrency, or making a system that needs to be correct AND fast. I find that intersection genuinely exciting.  📌 I'm open to Backend, AI/ML Engineering, and FullStack Engineering roles at product companies building things that matter.  📩 Feel free to message me directly — I respond to every thoughtful note.
